async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for the article
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('search').get_by_role('searchbox')
    await searchbox.fill('Beijing extends Mars mission lead; stranded astronauts back home: China’s year in space')
    search_button = page.get_by_role('search').get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
    
    # Step 2: Click on the article link
    article_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Beijing extends Mars mission lead; stranded astronauts back home: China’s year in space')
    await article_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
    
    # Step 3: Extract images from the article page
    result = await extract_images_from_page_manual(page, page.url)
    return result
